description: Save a resolution for ONE conflicted file of a PR, as a draft for the exact (base_sha, head_sha) pair merjax_list_pr_conflicts returned (a moved branch is refused: reload). Pass exactly one of: `content` (the whole resolved file — no conflict markers, at most 512 KiB), `choices` (hunk id → 'mine' | 'main' | 'both-mine-first' | 'both-main-first' | 'base' | 'ai' (the block's AI proposal from merjax_propose_pr_conflict_resolution) | {kind:'custom', lines:[…]}; applied server-side, a stale hunk id is refused), or `keep` ('mine' = the PR branch's version, 'main' = the base branch's; the only options for binary files and files one side deleted). Nothing is committed until merjax_commit_pr_conflict_resolution. Requires write access and 'repo' scope.

choices.description: Hunk id → mine | main | both-mine-first | both-main-first | base | ai | {kind:'custom', lines}

owner.description: Repo owner — username or organisation slug

name: merjax_resolve_pr_conflict
